title: Staircase Construction quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Construct an external timber staircase from an existing concrete patio up to a new elevated timber deck. The staircase has a total rise of 2.5 metres and a total run of 4.2 metres, with a finished width of 1.2 metres. It features two H4 treated pine stringers (250x50mm, 4.5m long each). There are 19 Merbau decking treads (1200x240x32mm) in an open riser design. A balustrade is required on one side, comprising three H4 treated pine posts (90x90mm) painted to match house trim, a Merbau timber handrail (65x42mm, 4.2 linear metres), and ten runs of 3.2mm stainless steel wire infill (42 linear metres total). All fixings are galvanised or stainless steel and BCA compliant. Treads and handrail require oiling; stringers and posts require painting.
workingDetail: Stair stringers (timber or steel), Treads and risers, Balustrade posts and handrail, Balustrade infill (glass, wire, timber)
